rules: Show BeaverCraft products (kits, knives, finished figures) in the first seconds. Wood carving only — no other crafts (no straw, weaving, painting), no stone or marble sculpture, no clay. Prefer BeaverCraft's own carving footage (hands carving wood, kits being opened, finished figures) over stock; no random stock people who are not carving wood. No text over faces.
